# 406 Cheap Rides

> Cheap car deal alerts around Billings, Montana.

406 Cheap Rides watches public car listings and emails you when a cheap deal shows up near Billings. Paid members get that email when a listing is new or the price drops. The free feed is the same deals, delayed 24 hours.

## Plans

- Monthly: $7 per month after a 7-day free trial
- Yearly: $49 per year after a 7-day free trial
- The card is collected up front. The plan auto-bills when the trial ends unless you cancel.
- Cancel anytime from the account page, which opens the Stripe billing portal. Access continues until the period ends.
- Partial periods are not refunded unless the law requires a refund.
- Text alerts are not offered yet.

## Categories

- Beater commuters: cars that get you to work without a car payment
- Winter beaters: cars that start in the cold
- First cars: simple and cheaper to insure
- Mechanic's specials: priced low because they need work
- Fun and cheap: a toy that still has to be a real deal

An empty category list on an account means every deal.

## Coverage

Billings, Montana and about 150 miles around it, including Laurel, Lockwood, Columbus, and Red Lodge.

## Listings

Listings come from public third-party marketplaces. Prices, photos, and availability can be wrong. 406 Cheap Rides is not a party to any vehicle sale.
